claims.evidence: Witness could not read a model number or distinguish Fat vs Slim/Pro from the photo; only a general PlayStation logo is visible.
No screen, menu, or firmware indicator is visible in the photo; this cannot be judged from a static image of the console's exterior.

claims.claim: Comes with FC26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: No discs, game case, or on-screen game library is shown in the photo; nothing in the report confirms or denies game contents.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults
risks.proof: Video of the console being powered on, reaching the home screen, and loading a game

risks.risk: Hacked/jailbroken status may mean unstable firmware, void warranty, or risk of bans/bricking
risks.proof: Screenshot or video of the system menu showing firmware version and CFW/jailbreak indicator
risks.if_unproven: priced as a modified unit with added risk, not as a stock working unit

risks.risk: Claimed games (FC26 + 8 others) may not actually be installed or may be pirated copies that stop working
risks.proof: Screenshot of the game library/home screen listing installed titles
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, games not counted

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, charging cable)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included cables laid out next to the console
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + controllers only, cables assumed missing

risks.risk: Unseen physical damage (dents, disc drive issues, port wear)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides, disc tray open, and ports

risks.risk: Controller battery health and connectivity not shown
risks.proof: Video of both controllers pairing and holding charge for a few minutes
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers with unknown battery life

proof_requests: Video of console powering on to home screen and loading a game
Photo of the model number sticker on the back/underside of the console
Screenshot of system settings showing firmware version or CFW status
Screenshot of the game library listing all installed titles
Photo of all included cables and accessories
Close-up photos of console body (all sides) and open disc tray
Short clip of both controllers connecting and functioning
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a PlayStation console with two controllers, so it can be priced at worst case, but the model variant, hacked status, and bundled games are all unverified and must be priced as unproven until supporting video/screenshots are provided.
